This '''individual''' was an aspiring [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who lived during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. He or she was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the [[Dark side adept/Legends|Dark Side Adept]] [[Vost Tyne]], who kept their [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] as a trophy.
